# Rear differential options and strength

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Select a Pro-4 or Off-Road differential, consider C200 for on-road use, and note gear/tire stresses. [t261]

## Tips & gotchas

- Consider the C200 diff in the rear as plenty strong if staying on-road. [t261]
- Note that 3.13 gears with 33-inch tires may stress a standard rear end. [t261]
